title: IKSSourceTraceability
description: Schema enforcing academic and research traceability for all IKS and conservation assertions.

author.description: Primary author, editor, technical committee, or issuing institution

evidence_type.description: Methodological basis of the source evidence

historical_period.description: Historical epoch or modern statutory era

relevant_region.description: Geographical or geological region to which the evidence applies

applicable_structure_types.description: Heritage water structure typologies validated by this source

confidence_limitations.description: Scientific limitations, uncertainties, or boundary assumptions of the source

practical_conservation_relevance.description: Direct application of this source to on-site conservation engineering

non_generalizable_conditions.description: Conditions or environments under which claims from this source must NOT be generalized

expert_verification_status.description: Conservation domain review and verification status

claim_supported.description: Specific conservation principle or material rule substantiated by this source

claims_supported.description: List of specific conservation, engineering, or hydrological claims substantiated by this source
